# Local zca-js transport patch

This SDK ships zca-js 2.2.0 under its original package name and version, with local corrections in exactly four runtime files: dist/utils.js, dist/cjs/utils.cjs, dist/apis/listen.js and dist/cjs/apis/listen.cjs. The other 573 upstream payload files, package metadata, declarations, API/Zalo classes, dependencies and MIT LICENSE are unchanged. The archive includes the original copyright and permission notice.

The patch selects automatic cookies using complete URLs, stores response cookies against their supplying URL, keeps caller headers separate from generated defaults, supports standard HeadersInit overrides and carries raw through visible redirects. Normal requests default to redirect:error and admit only undefined or primitive manual/error, rejecting every other redirect input before the adapter without coercion; visible origin changes remove Cookie, Authorization and Proxy-Authorization before destination-specific selection. The [cookie guide](../docs/cookie-scope.md) defines compatibility changes and remaining redirect/WebSocket limits. Each new Listener connection now selects current cookies for its complete socket URL synchronously; the existing socket guard is rechecked after the lookup to prevent a reentrant outer start from replacing an inner socket. Constructor behavior, handshake headers, agent, public declarations and remaining lifecycle behavior stay unchanged.

Response storage passes the original Set-Cookie string to the receiving jar after the existing parse guard, so a caller jar from a separate same-version tough-cookie installation can parse its own Cookie instance.

The adjacent JSON records original file and registry-integrity identities, patched file hashes, patch hash and deterministic local archive identity. Apply the adjacent unified patch to the exact upstream2.2.0 package tree to reproduce the four source changes; no consumer-side mutation or install hook is used. The local archive is a production file dependency and is also bundled in the SDK archive because a nested file-tar dependency alone is not portable through npm extraction.

The upstream version number identifies the source base; it does not mean this archive is byte-identical to the registry release. Resolve the dependency from this SDK when checking its actual API class. A separately installed upstream copy can have a different class identity and unpatched behavior. Installing or upgrading another zca-js copy does not update this bundled patch. No fork is published by creating this local package.
